title: Normalization of the canonical boundary pullback tensor comparison
statement: Let $j:Z\to X$ be any morphism of schemes and let $M,N$ be $\mathcal O_X$-modules [lem-sc-square-zero-ideal-tensor-unit]. Write $P$ for tensorPullback and $\eta$ for its chosen adjunction unit. For every open $U$ of $X$ and sections $s\in\Gamma(U,M)$, $t\in\Gamma(U,N)$, boundaryPullbackTensorIso sends $\eta_{M\otimes N}(s\otimes t)$ over $j^{-1}U$ to $\eta_M(s)\otimes\eta_N(t)$. No closed-immersion, invertibility or square-zero hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 01CD, lemma-tensor-product-pullback (proof omitted); Tag 0096, pullback adjunction; expansion of the tensor coefficients in Tag 09MS, coherent-equation-ses.

proof.text: Expand the adjunction comparison with Mathlib pullback. The unit-leftAdjointUniq equation says that the tensor-pullback unit followed by this comparison is the Mathlib pullback unit, for M, N and M tensor N.

Apply AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback_δ_app_unit_tmulSection to j, M, N, U, s and t. The inverse monoidal tensorator is definitionally the oplax cotensorator, so this gives exactly the middle section equation.

In the definition of boundaryPullbackTensorIso, the final inverse adjunction comparisons on the two factors cancel those supplied by the first step. This gives the asserted equality for every open. Linearity includes zero sections and zero modules; sheafification and restriction give the same equation on the empty open.

theorem boundaryPullbackTensorIso_unit_tmul {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : Z ⟶ X)
    (M N : X.Modules) (U : X.Opens) (s : Γ(M, U)) (t : Γ(N, U)) :
    (boundaryPullbackTensorIso j M N).hom.app (j ⁻¹ᵁ U)
        (((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction j)).unit.app (M ⊗ N)).app U
          (tmulSection s t)) =
      tmulSection (M := (tensorPullback j).obj M) (N := (tensorPullback j).obj N)
        (((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction j)).unit.app M).app U s)
        (((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction j)).unit.app N).app U t)
